intro.title: Move it with the arrow keys

lines.intro: In this lesson, you'll make your circle move with the arrow keys.
lines.recap: We start where lesson one ended: {player}the player is a teal circle, in the middle of the screen.
lines.forever: Open {click}Control, and drag {grab}forever under look like a circle. {frame}Everything inside forever runs again, every frame.
lines.if: From {click}Control again, drag {grab}if then into the forever loop.
lines.key: From {click}Sensing, drag {grab}key right arrow pressed into the slot of the if.
lines.move: Then from {click}Motion, drag {grab}change x by, inside the if, and make it {num}3.
lines.meaning: So, if {key}the right arrow key is pressed, {x}x grows by 3, and the circle moves right.
lines.left: Left is almost the same. {copy}Copy the if with control C and control V, put the copy underneath, pick left arrow, and type minus 3.
lines.up: Up and down change y instead. Drag another if under the others, put key pressed in it, and pick up arrow. Then add change y by, with minus 3.
lines.down: In the game, y grows downwards, so minus 3 goes up. {copy}One more copy for down arrow, with 3.
lines.run: Now press {click}Run, and {game}click the game, so it gets the keys.
lines.playing: The arrow keys move your circle around the screen.
lines.code: In the code, {if}each if became an IF with a key test, inside the LOOP that runs every frame.
lines.outro: Great work! {next}In lesson three, you'll catch a coin and keep score.
